result.rationale: The diff adds two hand-rolled mappings in EventManager.ts (createAllCalendarEvents and updateEvent paths) that reconstruct a credential object field-by-field from prisma.credential.findUnique (appName, id, type, key, userId, teamId, invalid, appId). If the Credential model gains a field needed by calendar services (e.g. a new key on key or a new property), these manual mappings will silently omit it, unlike the type-safe findUnique results used elsewhere. This is a specific, real maintainability/architecture risk created by this diff, not incorrect current behavior.

record.issue_text: EventManager.ts: hand-rolled credential field mapping will silently break if Credential model changes

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, when a credential isn’t found in `this.calendarCredentials`, the code fetches it from Prisma and then manually constructs a `credential` object by enumerating fields (`appName`, `id`, `type`, `key`, `userId`, `teamId`, `invalid`, `appId`). This hand-rolled mapping is diff-grounded and creates maintenance risk: if the `Credential`/`CredentialWithAppName` shape changes (new required fields, renamed fields, etc.), this path may diverge from the canonical model unless kept in sync. This is a design/robustness concern rather than a directly verifiable functional bug in this diff.
